caption: How much each side checked, per run (median over the runs kept: Megatron 2 vs 3 seeds, vLLM 3 vs 3, FastVideo one race each). Left: checks, i.e. scored checks plus screens, timed runs of the agent's code that are not scored (LiveLab: its in-process lab tool on FastVideo and live A/B runs on vLLM; Codex had no screening tool, so its screens are the benchmark and profiling scripts it ran itself). Right: hours spent in scored checks. Megatron and vLLM: 6 hours; FastVideo: 8 hours. Codex: the Codex agent checking each edit with a restart. LiveLab: the same agent, prompt and time budget, checking through LiveLab.
